title: Esc does not stop the tone while the deformation plays
detail: soundStop() gates the voice off but leaves snd.rest set. The next frame calls soundFunctionChanged('t'), sndRetrack re-evaluates, and sndHover calls v.gate(true). The tone is back within one frame. Bells, pings and the arrival keep playing. DESIGN §2.4 rule 5 says Esc stops any tone at once. Before this change a still pointer evaluated nothing, so Esc stayed silent until the pointer moved. With Loop on, the tone now never stops: the only ways out are moving the pointer off the plane or turning sound off.
evidence: c1.js case B (z^5, Phase view, pointer still, M then Esc at 0.71 s). Voice gate log: gate(false) at Esc, gate(true) 10 ms later, then every frame (27, 44, 60 ms ...). 54 voice set() calls in the 1.5 s after Esc. RMS: -41.5 dB before Esc, a dip to -49.6 dB for about 50 ms, then -41.5 dB again. A turn bell and the arrival played after Esc. det.py B: an engine hit at the Esc moment, -41.9 dB (the dip and re-gate). Recording rec/c1B. Scripts: notes/sound/review-deformation/ (pre.js + cN.js run in a CDP daemon on port 8952; rinj.js is the cdp3 recorder tap; det.py is notes/sound/cdp3/det.py). Recordings (rec/<name>.f32 + .json): <tmp> (session scratchpad; may be gone later). Build: work/xvs/dist/test.html as built at 12:20.
fix: In soundStop(): set snd.rest = null and snd.run = null, and cancel snd.fcRaf. The tone then comes back only on the next pointer move or keyboard probe step, as it did before. Add a check to sound_deform_cmd.js: press Esc during a play with a still pointer and expect no voice set() after it.

title: Default X -> Y view: pressing M with the pointer resting on X gives no tone until the pointer moves
detail: X -> Y is the default view. Opening the deformation there merges the panes into one plane. The rest is dropped: the needle key includes solo(), and the L canvas gets a pointerleave. The pointer still rests on a plane (the merged one), but nothing follows until it moves. This is the user's complaint, unchanged, in the default layout. After a 1 px move the tone follows (src 'merged'). DEFORMATION.md lists the merge as a case where nothing follows. The request is that the tone follows whenever the pointer rests on a plane.
evidence: c2.js case F (main 'xy', z^5, pointer at 1.2 e^{i170 deg} on X, key M). For 1.0 s after M: 0 voice set() calls, fcN 0, rest null, only morphStart. After a 1 px move: 36 voice set() calls in the remaining 0.6 s of play, rest.src 'merged'. Recording rec/arF. Scripts: notes/sound/review-deformation/ (pre.js + cN.js run in a CDP daemon on port 8952; rinj.js is the cdp3 recorder tap; det.py is notes/sound/cdp3/det.py). Recordings (rec/<name>.f32 + .json): <tmp> (session scratchpad; may be gone later). Build: work/xvs/dist/test.html as built at 12:20.
fix: Keep the pointer's client position in snd.rest. After a layout change (the end of applyLayout in openTransport and closeTransport, and setMain), pick the point under that position in the plane now under it: paneR.s2w for the merged plane, paneL for X, pickLand for the relief. Then rest there with the right src, treated as a swap (nearest turn, no cue). Do the same when the deformation closes (merged plane -> X).

title: A plain click on the plane drops the rest, so click then M plays silently
detail: The new capture-phase pointerdown listener drops snd.rest on any mouse or pen press, including a click that does not move (the code comment says 'a drag, a pan, a click'). A user who clicks the plane (to focus it, or by habit) and then presses M with the hand still gets no tone during the whole play. That is again the reported symptom. The reason given for dropping the rest, that the point under the pointer changed after a pan, does not hold for a click without movement.
evidence: c2.js case G (Phase view, z^5): pointer rests at p, a mouse click at p, then M. 0 voice set() calls in 2 s of play; rest null; only morphStart and morphEnd. Scripts: notes/sound/review-deformation/ (pre.js + cN.js run in a CDP daemon on port 8952; rinj.js is the cdp3 recorder tap; det.py is notes/sound/cdp3/det.py). Recordings (rec/<name>.f32 + .json): <tmp> (session scratchpad; may be gone later). Build: work/xvs/dist/test.html as built at 12:20.
fix: Drop the rest only when the press becomes a drag or pan: on the first pointermove with buttons pressed, or when the view key changes. On a pointerup with no movement, keep the rest, or set it again at the same z.

title: Zero and pole speech chatters every other frame and states false orders (z^50 - 1, sin(1/z))
detail: sndNear calls sndSay before it knows whether the engine played the ping. The audio has a gap and a cluster guard (a 250 ms gap, then 'dense' and 600 ms of quiet). The speech has neither. A still probe now re-evaluates every frame, which exposes a flip-flop in sndNear's hysteresis. Say one zero is inside the 8 px circle and a second sits in the 8 to 14 px ring. The 14 px order (2) differs from the held order (1), so near resets to 0, and the next frame pings again. That makes an attempt every other frame. Mathematical errors: two simple zeros in the 8 px disc are announced as 'Zero of order 2'. A disc that contains the essential singularity of sin(1/z) gives winding counts announced as 'Zero of order 29' and 'Pole of order 41', but there is no pole there. The audio guard works: for z^50 - 1 one ping, then one 'dense'.
evidence: c4.js case K (z^50 - 1, pointer at e^{i pi/50}, between two roots, one play). 13 live-region updates in 535 ms, about every 33 ms: 'Zero of order 1 here.' x12, then 'Zero of order 2 here.'. Of 13 ping requests, 2 played (a ping and the dense cue). Case L (sin(1/z), pointer at 0.05 + 0.01i, which is 6 px from 0). 18 announcements in 630 ms, including 'Zero of order 29 here.', 'Zero of order 16 here.', 'Pole of order 41 here.', 'Pole of order 32 here.' and 'Pole of order 24 here.' twice. In c3.js the same chains gave 12+1 and 18 requests per 1.6 s play. Recordings rec/arK2 and rec/arL2. Scripts: notes/sound/review-deformation/ (pre.js + cN.js run in a CDP daemon on port 8952; rinj.js is the cdp3 recorder tap; det.py is notes/sound/cdp3/det.py). Recordings (rec/<name>.f32 + .json): <tmp> (session scratchpad; may be gone later). Build: work/xvs/dist/test.html as built at 12:20.
fix: (1) Speak only when SND.play returned true. When 'dense' plays, say 'Many zeros or poles here.' once. Also never repeat the same text within about 1.5 s. (2) Hysteresis: keep near while the 14 px circle gives any nonzero count, or re-test with the 8 px circle instead of comparing the 14 px order with the held one. (3) Before saying 'order m' for m >= 2, check that a smaller circle (4 px) gives the same count. Two simple zeros give a different count there; a true multiple zero does not. (4) Treat |m| above a bound (say 8), or a count that does not settle between radii, as no landmark, which covers essential singularities. Add sin(1/z) and z^50 - 1 with a still probe to sound_deform_cmd.js, counting #sndLive updates.

title: Landscape: the 0.15 s swap glide is cut to one frame, so the pitch drops fast at every open and loop repeat
detail: On a swap (the transport opening, a loop repeat), sndHover sets the Height voice with glide 0.15. The next frame's set() asks for glide max(dt, 0.008), about 17 ms, to almost the same target. That replaces the running glide, so the rest of the 0.15 s is squeezed into one frame. The swap glide that DEFORMATION.md gives as the fix for the +3.7 dB event at the open does not happen while frames keep coming. It does happen at the close, where frames stop. The Phase (Shepard) voice is clean at loop repeats.
evidence: c5.js case P (Landscape, z^5, Loop on, events on). The worklet command log at a loop repeat shows moveH dur 0.15, then 16 ms later moveH dur 0.0167 to almost the same target (lf 9.4616 vs 9.4617). Zero-crossing frequency: 1700 Hz to 700 Hz in about 35 ms. det.py B: 12 engine hits, 11 at or above -50 dB, worst -12.9 dB at the second repeat and -25.7 dB at the first. c10.js (events off, so no cue can mask it): -16.4 dB at the repeat. c11.js (with a 0.4 s lead): -35.0 dB at the open, -23.3 dB at the repeat. Detector A found 0 in all three, so this is not a snap by DESIGN §7.6's A rule. But B is 25 to 35 dB above the verified build's worst action case (-48 dB), and it repeats on every loop. Phase view loop repeats (c1.js case E): B 0. Recordings rec/arP, rec/arP2, rec/arP3. Scripts: notes/sound/review-deformation/ (pre.js + cN.js run in a CDP daemon on port 8952; rinj.js is the cdp3 recorder tap; det.py is notes/sound/cdp3/det.py). Recordings (rec/<name>.f32 + .json): <tmp> (session scratchpad; may be gone later). Build: work/xvs/dist/test.html as built at 12:20.
fix: Keep the swap's glide alive. Store snd.glideTo = performance.now() + 150 and, while it lasts, pass glide = max(remaining time, dt) on the following set() calls. Or have the worklet's moveH keep the longer of the running glide's remaining time and the new dur when the target barely changes. Add a Landscape loop repeat, events off, to the click regression, with a check on B as well as A.

title: Turn bells depend on tempo: a slow scrub or a pause loses the turns
detail: The run (the counter behind the bells) resets 1.6 s after the function stops changing. Keyboard scrubbing, the accessible way to step through t, often has longer gaps than that. Each step then starts a new run at 0, and no bell rings however many turns go by. A pause of more than 1.6 s mid-play has the same effect: turns made before the pause are forgotten. The pitch still follows exactly, so the bells disagree with the winding the user hears.
evidence: c12.js (z^9 at 1.2 e^{i170 deg}; the winding of t -> H_t(z) over [0, 1] is 3.778 turns, matching an independent sampling in c3.js case H). PageUp x10 on #morphRange with 0.7 s gaps: 3 bells, run 3.778. Same with 1.9 s gaps: 0 bells, run 0.378. Total phi moved by +3.78 turns in both. Scripts: notes/sound/review-deformation/ (pre.js + cN.js run in a CDP daemon on port 8952; rinj.js is the cdp3 recorder tap; det.py is notes/sound/cdp3/det.py). Recordings (rec/<name>.f32 + .json): <tmp> (session scratchpad; may be gone later). Build: work/xvs/dist/test.html as built at 12:20.
fix: Tie the run to the transport, not to wall time. Keep it while the rest, the chain key and the frame key stay the same and the transport stays open. Reset it on a swap, a play the user starts from 0, or a probe move. Keep the 1.6 s timeout only for changes outside the transport (v15 Params).

title: Merged-plane tone: the decision is sound, but the screen labels the pointer w and nothing shows H_t(p)
detail: Reading the pointer's point p as a point of X and sounding H_t(p) is a coherent choice for a mathematician: it is the head of the path that starts under the pointer, and it matches the Phase view's tone at p. Rejecting arg w (constant in t) is right. But the merged plane's readout says 'w 0.6000 + 0.5000i |w| 0.7810' for the same pointer, while the tone plays |H_t(p)| = 0.673 at arg 63.7 deg (arg w = 39.8 deg). So the label and the sound disagree. Nothing is drawn at H_t(p): there is no head and no path, so the tone describes a point the user cannot see. 'Zero of order 1 here.' is said when H_t has a zero at p in X's coordinates. On the merged plane that event shows elsewhere, where the image of p crosses w = 0. The choice is documented only in DEFORMATION.md, not in DESIGN §2.5.
evidence: c9.js (z^2, merged plane at t = 0.6, pointer resting at 0.6 + 0.5i): readout 'w 0.6000 + 0.5000i |w| 0.7810'; snd.g = H_0.6(p) = 0.2985 + 0.6036i, which agrees with hAt. Screenshot notes/sound/review-deformation/merged_t06.png: legend 'X' and 't -> H_t(z)'; no marker at H_t(p); axis label 'z -> w deformation'. Scripts: notes/sound/review-deformation/ (pre.js + cN.js run in a CDP daemon on port 8952; rinj.js is the cdp3 recorder tap; det.py is notes/sound/cdp3/det.py). Recordings (rec/<name>.f32 + .json): <tmp> (session scratchpad; may be gone later). Build: work/xvs/dist/test.html as built at 12:20.
fix: While a probe rests on the merged plane, draw its path t -> H_t(p) from p to the current head, in the style of the Paths feature. Change the readout to 'z = p, H_t(z) = ...'. Word the speech for this plane as 'H_t has a zero here (the path from here passes through 0)'. Add the decision to DESIGN §2.5.

title: Switching views mid-play stops the following, and the old voice holds a stale pitch
detail: After a view switch during a play (Phase <-> Landscape, X -> Y <-> Phase), the needle key changes, so sndRetrack returns until the pointer moves. The Phase voice holds its last pitch while the picture keeps moving, then fades 1.6 s later. Coming back to the original view picks the run up again correctly (the run stayed exact: 1.889 turns, 1 bell). There is no snap (B 0).
evidence: c1.js case D (z^5: Phase, then Landscape at 0.6 s, then Phase at 1.3 s). 65 voice set() calls in 2.8 s, against 96 for an uninterrupted play. None during the 0.7 s in the Landscape. Run 1.8889, 1 bell. Recording rec/c1D (A 0, B 0). title: Keyboard probe: during a play the 280 ms sample becomes a continuous tone, forever with Loop on
detail: The keyboard probe sounds a 280 ms sample so the tone does not talk over a screen reader (DESIGN §2.4). Every frame of a play resets that idle timer, so the tone sounds for the whole of each 1.6 s play. With Loop on it never stops. Speech from snddef-4 adds to it.
evidence: c5.js case R (the keyboard probe at 0 + 0.1i, z^5, Loop on, M): 191 voice set() calls and 191 gate-ons in 5 s. The last set() was at 4.25 s (still playing). Gate-offs only during the end holds. Recording rec/arR (A 0, B 0). Scripts: notes/sound/review-deformation/ (pre.js + cN.js run in a CDP daemon on port 8952; rinj.js is the cdp3 recorder tap; det.py is notes/sound/cdp3/det.py). Recordings (rec/<name>.f32 + .json): <tmp> (session scratchpad; may be gone later). Build: work/xvs/dist/test.html as built at 12:20.
fix: For src 'key', keep a short sample during a play: sound at the start, at each bell or ping, and at the arrival, about 280 ms each, or follow t only while a scrub key moves it. Or offer this as a setting. Decide this with the a11y review.

title: The hook's no-argument form drops exact tracking; path evaluations are never costed
detail: (a) Each soundFunctionChanged() call with no argument bumps fcGen, so the next evaluation uses the nearest-turn rule: no cut ticks, and a bell is miscounted when arg moves more than half a turn in a frame. If v15 calls it every frame from a Params Play while the transport also plays, t loses its exact path too. (b) Path steps make fewer than 4 calls an event, so the cost estimator never updates. perEval stayed at its 0.002 ms default in every run, including the heavy chain. Each call of sndFAt runs homView(), which builds both morphState(true) and morphState(false), and the probe never uses the second. Only the 3 ms deadline guards the budget. Frame rate is fine today: the heavy chain played at 60 fps at 1x and 4x CPU, with sound off, Hear F off and Hear F on alternating. Sound off gave 0 evaluations.
evidence: c8.js: heavy (erf, tan, log chain, all at once, 0.5x speed). At 1x: fps 60.0/60.1/60.0/60.0/60.0, p95 17.4 to 17.6 ms, 0 intervals over 20 ms in every mode. At 4x: fps 60.1 to 60.5, p95 18.0 to 19.2 ms, over-20 ms intervals 1/0/1/2/4 (the most with sound off). Evaluations: 0 with sound off or Hear F off, 150 to 152 with Hear F on. perEval 0.002 throughout. Scripts: notes/sound/review-deformation/ (pre.js + cN.js run in a CDP daemon on port 8952; rinj.js is the cdp3 recorder tap; det.py is notes/sound/cdp3/det.py). Recordings (rec/<name>.f32 + .json): <tmp> (session scratchpad; may be gone later). Build: work/xvs/dist/test.html as built at 12:20.
fix: Let the hook take an optional path, e.g. soundFunctionChanged({ at: (u) => F_u }), so a parameter slider is tracked like t. Document that v15 should not call the bare form every frame while the transport plays. In sndFAt, use morphState(true).F directly. Add path-step calls to the cost average even when r.evals < 4.
